scope_label: Untrained design · two YAM arms and a manual screw vise. Static pose only.

videos.title: Inspect the design
videos.caption: One arm holds the workpiece; the other is positioned at the crank. This is a design pose, not an executed grasp or tightening motion.

metrics.label: Independent IK samples
metrics.detail: Seven separate upper-half-turn poses. This does not validate the path between them.

limitations: No trained policy or executed motion.
Gripper closure, handle grasp, torque transfer and full swept collision remain untested.
Zero sampled arm-to-arm penetration; full fixture clearance remains unvalidated.
title: Two arms tighten a vise
prompt: Have two YAMs hold stock and tighten a manual vise together.
preparation: Prepared assets and prior experiment evidence. Live configuration compiles a new copy of the selected template; it does not retrain the policy.

stages.title: Concept image
stages.description: Prepared AI-generated visual direction. Illustrative, not physics evidence or an exact CAD specification.

stages.title: CAD & workcell
stages.description: Actual YAM meshes and task geometry. Static design pose; grasp and motion unvalidated.

stages.title: Simulation & checks
stages.description: Compile and validate a fresh prepared environment bundle. Manual task reward, termination and contact manipulation still require implementation.

stages.title: Learned skills
stages.description: Not trained: contact grasp/turn/regrasp validation required.
